title: Today (live)
line: Dark ray ground, an empty cream strip beside the filter, Apple as a blown-up dotted logo on halftone.

title: U1 · Ringside at dusk · $0.09
line: The ring at dusk opens the tab; filter = tape on the painted ropes; main event = the belt with the mark engraved in its gold plate; undercard = tickets in each company's colour on painted stock.

title: U2 · The fight bill · $0.06
line: Each fight night is one two-ink letterpress poster pasted on the painted wall: main event in wood type, mark printed in black ink, undercard as lower billing.

title: U3 · The box office · $0.10
line: Second reading of 'the top': the arena's box office at night, 'Next on the card' on its marquee; every round a risograph ticket overprinted in the company's colour.

title: U4 · The ring from above · $0.57 (2K ring)
line: Every bout is a ring seen from the rafters: the mark printed in the spotlight, the four AIs in the four corners with their calls; day heads are banners in the walkout tunnel.

title: U5 · The fight programme · $0.09
line: The night's souvenir programme in risograph inks: tale of the tape for the main event, the company's market cap as its weight, the four AIs in the other corner.

title: U6 · Their name in lights · $0.42
line: U1, but the main event opens on its own painting: the company's real mark built as a lit sign over the rooftop ring (Apple accepted; AMD's mark came out wrong twice, so it keeps the belt).
